name: Macy
source:
Macy is a high-strung and nervous member of the Slums, missing her life in heaven. 

One of her notable habits is coveting old communicative tech, in hopes of receiving an answer from someone. 

[Edited from [url=https://rosesrot.itch.io/seraphim-slum]itch.io[/url]]
